connections.how: Turn around with the upper low white cabinet row on your right and walk across the wood floor toward the atrium staircase.
Pass the cube bookshelf on your right and the upper white pillar by cube bookshelf on your left, continuing straight along the edge of the atrium staircase.

connections.how: Keep the SYMA wall mural on your right and the atrium staircase on your left, walking straight ahead to the doors at the end of the floor opening.

connections.from: upper restroom doors with blue figures
connections.how: With the upper restroom doors with blue figures behind you, turn right past the upper red fire extinguisher and walk along the edge of the atrium staircase.
Walk with the SYMA wall mural on your left and the atrium staircase on your right, then bear left past the cube bookshelf toward the green bamboo wall art.
Pass the black armchair and green bamboo wall art on your right, then turn left onto the gray floor toward the windows.
From the windows by the desk with dual monitors, turn around and walk past the desk and village mural above white cabinets on your left toward the photo-covered cabinet doors ahead.
Step out past the cabinet with photo grid on your right onto the wood floor, then turn right into the gray-floored area with the green bamboo wall art on your left.

connections.to: upper restroom doors with blue figures

connections.from: upper restroom doors with blue figures

connections.to: upper restroom doors with blue figures

At the bottom of the lower flight of the atrium staircase, turn right and walk past the SYMA display wall with cabinet on your left.
Walk past the SYMA display wall with cabinet on your left toward the red swivel chair by the windows, then turn right.

connections.to: lower restroom doors with blue figures
connections.how: Turn around and walk past the SYMA display wall with cabinet on your right and the bottom of the atrium staircase, then turn left at the lower red fire extinguisher by stairs.

connections.to: lower restroom doors with blue figures
connections.how: Descend the lower flight of the atrium staircase to the bottom facing the white wall, then turn left into the narrow passage.

connections.from: lower restroom doors with blue figures
connections.how: Walk along the narrow passage with the lower restroom doors with blue figures on your left and wall-mounted whiteboard on your right, then turn right onto the bottom step of the stairs.

connections.from: lower restroom doors with blue figures
connections.how: Walk straight down the narrow passage with the lower restroom doors with blue figures on your right and wall-mounted whiteboard on your left, emerging into the open area with the white chairs and table ahead.

connections.to: lower restroom doors with blue figures
connections.how: With the wooden counter with patchwork art behind you, walk straight into the narrow passage between the white walls with the lower restroom doors with blue figures on your left.
Pass the SYMA display wall with cabinet on your left and square beige planter ahead, curving right to walk underneath the atrium staircase.
Continue forward from under the atrium staircase past the blue-and-white sign board and square beige planter on your left toward the dark floor mat and counter ahead.
Walk past the dark floor mat and blue reception counter on your left, then turn right between the lower low white cabinet row on your left and the metal frame around pillar on your right.
Near the blue reception counter and glass double doors with exit sign, walk into the aisle with the lower low white cabinet row on your left and the lower yellow desk partition on your right.
From the window wall, walk back along the aisle with the lower yellow desk partition on your left and lower low white cabinet row on your right until you reach the planter at the end of the cabinets.
Turn left at the lower tall brown planter and walk straight toward the curved blue wall ahead.
Turn around with the blue curved wall with poster behind you and walk past the lower tall brown planter on your left toward the framed column ahead.
Walk past the metal frame around pillar on your right and the green booth with TV, heading straight toward the wavy glass partition and potted floor plant.
Pass the floor plant by wavy glass and wavy glass partition on your right, walking straight to the white door labeled 'Produktion' and its red fire extinguisher on the left wall.

connections.to: lower restroom doors with blue figures
connections.how: Turn around from the Produktion door, walk past the wavy glass partition and floor plant by wavy glass on your left and the green booth with TV on your right, and curve left into the narrow passage.

connections.from: upper restroom doors with blue figures
connections.how: At the top of the atrium staircase, turn left past the blue glass partition on your left, then curve left toward the ribbed dark planter and vertical wood-slat wall.
Walk straight with the wood-slat wall with brochure rack on your right and the long white table with white chairs on your left to the easel in the corner.
Turn left around the end of the long white table with white chairs, passing the sliding door with gray squares on your right to reach the curved curtain wall.

connections.to: upper restroom doors with blue figures

connections.to: glass double doors with exit sign

connections.from: glass double doors with exit sign

connections.from: glass double doors with exit sign

connections.from: upper restroom doors with blue figures
connections.how: At the top of the atrium staircase, turn left past the blue glass partition and upper white pillar by blue glass partition on your left, then walk straight with the upper yellow desk partition on your right to the metal shelves against the wall ahead.

walk_summary: Start on the upper level wood floor near the round wall relief, upper low white cabinet row, and upper tall brown planter, turning around to face the atrium staircase.
Walk past the cube bookshelf and upper white pillar by cube bookshelf, continuing along the SYMA wall mural to the upper restroom doors with blue figures.

Turn left at the upper restroom doors with blue figures and blue planter, walk down the upper flight of the atrium staircase to the mid-landing, then turn around and climb back up to the upper restroom doors with blue figures and upper red fire extinguisher.
Turn right and walk back along the SYMA wall mural and atrium staircase, bearing left past the green bamboo wall art and black armchair into the gray-floored area.

Walk past the desk with dual monitors and village mural above white cabinets to the windows, turn around toward the cabinet with photo grid, and briefly loop into the area with the upper yellow desk partition and green bamboo wall art.

Step back onto the wood floor, walk past the upper white pillar by cube bookshelf, upper red fire extinguisher, and upper restroom doors with blue figures, and descend both flights of the atrium staircase to the lower level.

At the bottom of the stairs, walk right past the SYMA display wall with cabinet toward the red swivel chair and photo-covered white cabinets, then turn around and walk back past the atrium staircase and square beige planter to the lower red fire extinguisher by stairs.

Turn left into the narrow passage, walking past the lower restroom doors with blue figures on the right and wall-mounted whiteboard on the left to emerge by the white chairs and table and wooden counter with patchwork art.
Turn around and walk back through the narrow passage past the lower restroom doors with blue figures and wall-mounted whiteboard to the bottom of the atrium staircase.
Turn right and climb both flights of the atrium staircase past the blue glass partition to the upper restroom doors with blue figures and blue planter.

Turn left at the top of the stairs toward the upper yellow desk partition, turn back past the blue planter, upper red fire extinguisher, and upper white pillar by cube bookshelf, then turn around and descend the atrium staircase back to the lower level.

At the bottom of the stairs, turn right past the SYMA display wall with cabinet and square beige planter, ducking under the atrium staircase past the blue-and-white sign board to reach the dark floor mat and blue reception counter.
Walk past the blue reception counter and turn right between the lower low white cabinet row and metal frame around pillar toward the lower tall brown planter.
Turn around toward the glass double doors with exit sign and blue reception counter, then walk down the aisle between the lower low white cabinet row and lower yellow desk partition to the windows.
Turn around at the windows, walk back out of the aisle to the lower tall brown planter, and turn left to approach the blue curved wall with poster.

Turn around from the blue curved wall with poster, walk across the wood floor past the metal frame around pillar and green booth with TV, and pass the wavy glass partition and floor plant by wavy glass to reach the Produktion door and red fire extinguisher by Produktion door.

Turn around from the Produktion door, walk between the floor plant by wavy glass and green booth with TV, and follow the narrow passage past the lower restroom doors with blue figures to the bottom of the atrium staircase.
Turn right and climb both flights of the atrium staircase to the upper restroom doors with blue figures and blue planter.

Turn left at the top of the stairs past the blue glass partition, curving left past the ribbed dark planter to walk between the wood-slat wall with brochure rack and the long white table with white chairs to the white flipchart easel.
Turn left around the long white table with white chairs, passing the sliding door with gray squares and walking along the sheer white curtains and wall-mounted glass board to exit the doorway.

Turn right past the upper restroom doors with blue figures and blue planter, and descend both flights of the atrium staircase to the lower restroom doors with blue figures and lower red fire extinguisher by stairs.

Turn left down the narrow passage past the lower restroom doors with blue figures and wall-mounted whiteboard, then turn right past the green booth with TV into the open wood-floored area by the metal frame around pillar and rotate in place.

Walk past the lower white pillar by stairs, SYMA display wall with cabinet, and square beige planter toward the lower yellow desk partition, then turn around to face the blue-and-white sign board under the atrium staircase.
Walk past the blue reception counter and dark floor mat, exiting through the glass double doors with exit sign and past the silver dome trash can to the exterior SYMA sign outside.
Turn around and re-enter past the exterior SYMA sign, silver dome trash can, and glass double doors with exit sign onto the dark floor mat by the blue reception counter.

Walk across the wood floor between the atrium staircase and metal frame around pillar, curving right between the green booth with TV and the wavy glass partition and floor plant by wavy glass to reach the white chairs and table, wooden counter with patchwork art, and white drawer counter with wood top.

Turn around at the white drawer counter with wood top, walk past the wavy glass partition and through the narrow passage past the lower restroom doors with blue figures to the bottom of the atrium staircase.
Climb both flights of the atrium staircase past the blue glass partition to the upper restroom doors with blue figures, blue planter, and upper red fire extinguisher.

Turn left past the upper white pillar by blue glass partition and walk between the white wall and upper yellow desk partition toward the metal shelving unit, then turn right along the upper low white cabinet row toward the red swivel chair and desk with dual monitors by the windows.
